status: standalone foundation prototype; not integrated/committed; build gates NOT RUN pending root host slot
scope: ID/rank indexed queue foundation plus independent reference-model tests only. No wire/mempool/scheduler/lock integration, body refs or admission suffix API.
design: One owning unordered-map node per TxId; stable node pointers indexed by live minheap or intrusive stale doubly-linked tail. Rehash preserves node pointers. Exact erase/rekey creates no abandoned heap entries.

Live-first increasing supplied entry ID, deterministic TxId tie only for isolated equal-rank users. Stale tail follows transition-to-stale order; unchanged duplicate leaves order intact. Caller must discover authoritative membership/rank updates.
SetRank insertion or stale->live heap allocation happens before unlink/update; insertion failure erases the new map record. Copy/move disabled to prevent cross-container dangling node links.
No internal synchronization or retained transaction body/reference. No production lookup-path changes.
tests: Live/stale ordering, empty/missing ops and all counts
Initially stale->earlier live; rank raise/removal/re-admission; repeated duplicate stale updates; exact known-style erase and clear/reuse
Arbitrary live root/leaf/interior and stale head/tail/interior erases and rank lowering/raising

5000 deterministic operations against independent full-scan map reference model (insert/rekey/live/stale/pop/erase/clear, count/order checks each step); checks selected record Find() rank/membership as well as next candidate and counts
100K backlog,1000 unchanged peeks with zero injected rank comparisons;10 turns of17 pops each bounded below64 comparisons/pop, no full temporary heap build
